+++ b/src/_pytest/unique_argument_dirs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.config.findpaths import get_dirs_from_args
+
+
+def unique_argument_dirs(args: Iterable[str]) -> list[Path]:
+    """Return the directories given in the command-line arguments, like
+    :func:`_pytest.config.findpaths.get_dirs_from_args`, but with repeated
+    directories removed, preserving first-seen order.
+
+    Used for a root-search preview which requires unique directories.
+    """
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(get_dirs_from_args(args)))
